question: Which of the following antitussive can lead to hallucinations
analysis: Dextromethorphan is known to cause hallucinations, especially when taken in high doses. It acts on the NMDA receptor and can lead to dissociative effects similar to those of certain hallucinogens. Morphine and diphenhydramine can have sedative effects, but they are not primarily associated with hallucinations. Aprepitant is an antiemetic and does not typically cause hallucinations.
